stories.title: Deestriders member completes 64-mile Beacons Way ultra
stories.summary: Deestriders RC runner Paul Lewtey won the Rhes y Cae 10k on Saturday in 40:06. Christine Cammillare was second lady at the Flintshire race in 48:19, with Guy Christall finishing in 56:21. stories.title: North Wales ketamine campaign launched as hospital admissions climb
stories.summary: Emergency department admissions linked to ketamine in North Wales rose from 241 in 2023 to 412 in 2025, an increase of 71% in two years. stories.title: Taxis found in dangerous condition during Chester checks
stories.summary: Two taxi licences have been suspended after vehicles were found to be in a dangerous condition during a licensing operation in Chester at the weekend. stories.title: North Wales Police issue warning after fire started in Wepre Park area
stories.summary: Park rangers put out a fire in the Wepre Park area of Connah’s Quay after it smouldered overnight. North Wales Police said the fire was started the previous day and was still burning when it was found the following morning. Rangers reached it before it spread further. stories.title: Man airlifted from Mostyn Docks after coastguard rescue
stories.summary: An injured casualty was airlifted from Mostyn Docks on Sunday afternoon after coastguard teams decided a helicopter was the safest way to get them off the site. Flint Coastguard Rescue Team led the response and was joined by the Llandudno team. Crews treated the casualty at the scene before calling in the coastguard helicopter Rescue
